work.description: Actual address names the Bavarian internuncio Michael Prela; the body authorizes conferral of the defined faculty on Bishop Henry Hoefstaellen of Passau, preserves reservations and ends in a complete dating clause. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7458–7458; the source closing at LF7517–7520 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava aprilis millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo..
